title: Bayes with No Shame: Admissibility Geometries of Predictive Inference
abstract: arXiv:2603.05335v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern predictive systems combine predictors, sequential monitors, prediction sets, and online strategies, each with a different certificate of optimality. We study four criterion-relative geometries: Blackwell risk dominance, anytime-valid admissibility, fixed-level marginal coverage with expected-length efficiency within a declared rank-indexed family, and choice-based approachability (CApp) boundary-feasibility. We embed the four procedure types in a common product space and prove witness-based pairwise non-nesting: for every ordered pair of criterion classes, an explicit predictive system is active in both relevant coordinates, belongs to one class, and fails the other. The result records non-nesting across different object spaces and partial orders; it does not assert practical incompatibility. We separate three measure-relative coherence notions. translated_title: 无羞耻的贝叶斯：预测推断的可采纳性几何
translated_abstract: arXiv:2603.05335v3 公告类型：替换-交叉  摘要：现代预测系统结合了预测器、顺序监控器、预测集和在线策略，每种都具有不同的最优性证明。我们研究了四种标准相关的几何结构：布莱克韦尔风险优势、任意时间有效性可采纳性、固定水平边际覆盖与在声明秩索引族内的期望长度效率，以及基于选择的可达性（CApp）边界可行性。我们将四种过程类型嵌入一个共同的产品空间，并证明基于见证者的成对非嵌套性：对于每对有序的标准类别，存在一个显式预测系统在两个相关坐标中都是活跃的，属于一个类别，但在另一个类别中失败。该结果记录了不同对象空间和偏序之间的非嵌套性；它并不主张实际上的不兼容性。我们区分了三种测度相关的连贯性概念。在条件独立同分布模型中，在单一先验下的后验预测均值……
tldr: 本文通过共同产品空间中的成对非嵌套性证明，揭示了四种预测推断标准（如风险优势、有效性、覆盖率等）之间不存在包含关系，并区分了测度相关的连贯性概念。
en_tdlr: This paper proves pairwise non-nesting among four predictive inference criteria via a common product space, showing no criterion class contains another, and separates measure-relative coherence notions.
